$comment: Issue #1534 anchor ratchet. Every entry is PRE-EXISTING citation debt in a row owned by another issue, captured so the #1534 gate could be landed without editing rows it does not own. An entry is NOT approved drift: it records a citation whose adjacent identifier does not occur in the cited line range. This baseline may only SHRINK — scripts/check-registry-citations.ts fails when an entry starts passing, which forces its removal. Keyed on (rowId, file, identifier); line numbers are deliberately excluded so line churn cannot invalidate an entry. Regenerate with `bun run scripts/check-registry-citations.ts --write` (review the diff — --write will also happily record NEW drift).
